decisions.decision: Concrete live owner examples must be preserved in roadmap steps in compact form.
Executor may report a materially better implementation option but must not silently replace roadmap intent.
Use SHORT, BALANCED and EXPANDED review levels; expanded reports explain internal terms and include synthetic options for open questions.
Prefer absorbing capabilities into existing modules; create new modules only when clearly justified.
Persistent business data belongs in a centralized managed data layer or official asset storage; modules own semantics/interfaces rather than isolated business databases.
Rename Operational Registry to Operations Control Registry; proposed technical ID operations_control_registry.
Absorb Contract Registry capability into Integration Gateway unless repository inventory proves a distinct required domain.
Do not burden Integration Gateway with legacy 1C normalization; keep 1C adapter/reconciliation near the accounting/operational accounting boundary.
Project Inspector performs deterministic rule-based checking and reports; Blueprint provides analytical/architectural judgment.
Library must support dynamic canonical reference data, revisions, deprecation and controlled refresh.
Website should reuse shared Identity, Calculator, order/payment services rather than duplicate them.
Mobile App remains planned/deferred until a richer synthetic capability map is reviewed.
Use a centralized ForPrint Identity & Access Service for authentication/authorization across user-facing clients.
Cloud Backup Manager is backup/restore/retention/versioning; System Administration owns live machines, OS, applications, storage health and workstation drift.
Prepress defines required production software/tool profiles; System Administration installs, maintains and verifies them.
Channel layer must preserve full communication history in central persistence and support low-cost media identity/semantic context for AI escalation.
Plan Ukrainian, English and Russian support in client-facing modules; design i18n structure early, finalize translations late.
Plan urgent voice notifications and later bounded interactive AI calling as a communication-channel capability.
Warehouse remains a likely physical-stock authority, but final KEEP/ABSORB decision is deferred to expanded review.
Do not approve or retire until expanded KEEP/ABSORB/RETIRE review explains unique authority and value.
